rows.note: Use 機構 as the all-purpose choice for an established organization or institution, rather than a physical shop.

example.english: This establishment specializes in finding jobs for grassroots families.
example.traditional: 呢個機構專門幫基層家庭搵工作。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 bong1 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4 wan2 gung1 zok3

rows.note: Use 舖頭 for the physical commercial premises or business itself, especially a shop or small restaurant.

example.english: The fish balls at this establishment are delicious.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou2 tau4 di1 jyu4 daan2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use 建制派 for a political establishment or organized camp supporting the existing system.

example.english: The establishment supports maintaining the status quo.
example.jyutping: gin3 zai3 paai3 zi1 ci4 wai4 ci4 jin6 zong6

rows.note: Use 權貴 when the establishment means powerful, privileged people rather than an institution or political camp.

example.english: The establishment controls a lot of resources.
example.jyutping: kyun4 gwai3 hung3 zai3 zyu6 hou2 do1 zi1 jyun4
